values.label: 4 steps
values.note: Clean, but the skin goes smooth and waxy.

values.label: 6 steps
values.note: Close to 8, a touch softer.

values.label: 8 steps
values.note: The default. Sharp ring, clear stitching on the gloves.

values.label: 10 steps
values.note: Hard to tell from 8.

values.label: 12 steps
values.note: Hard to tell from 8, a little more texture.

values.label: 16 steps
values.note: Still good, and it picks up film grain.

values.label: 25 steps
values.note: Starts to look hyper-real. The skin gets blotchy, and seed 2121 grows a second ring.

values.label: euler
values.note: Almost the same picture as the default.

values.label: res_multistep
values.note: The default in ComfyUI's Z-Image template.

values.label: dpmpp_2m
values.note: Almost the same picture as the default.

values.label: dpmpp_sde
values.note: Adds noise every step, so the face and pose change, and it takes twice as long. On seed 2121 he looks up.

values.label: uni_pc
values.note: Close to the default.

values.label: er_sde
values.note: Changes the pose, and the ring nearly disappears on seed 2121.

values.label: euler_ancestral
values.note: Changes the pose.

values.label: lcm
values.note: Softer and flatter.

values.label: simple
values.note: The default.

values.label: beta
values.note: A little more texture in the leather and the bronze.

values.label: sgm_uniform
values.note: Same as simple.

values.label: karras
values.note: Broken. Soft and orange, and the detail melts.

values.label: normal
values.note: Same as simple.

values.label: exponential
values.note: Broken. Blurry, with a screen-door pattern over everything.

values.label: CFG 1
values.note: The default.

values.label: CFG 1.5
values.note: More contrast. The bronze pops.

values.label: CFG 2
values.note: A little too warm and washed out, but usable.

values.label: CFG 3
values.note: Burned.

values.label: CFG 4
values.note: Destroyed.

values.label: Shift 1
values.note: Gritty, heavy skin texture. Could suit a rougher look.

values.label: Shift 2
values.note: Close to 3, with a bit more texture.

values.label: Shift 3
values.note: The default.

values.label: Shift 5
values.note: Smoother.

values.label: Shift 7
values.note: Smoother still. Seed 3434 barely changes from 3.

values.label: 1024×576
values.note: Fast, and the least detail.

values.label: 1344×768
values.note: The default.

values.label: 1600×896
values.note: A little more detail.

values.label: 1920×1088
values.note: More detail in the armor and the brooches.

values.label: 2048×1152
values.note: The framing starts to move.

values.label: 2560×1440
values.note: The most detail of anything here, but the light goes flatter and he moves in the frame.

values.label: DPM++ 2M Karras, 25 steps
values.note: Rough, blotchy skin, and two and a half times as long.
